why: Each figure is the one before it turned 90 degrees clockwise. The small box with the + goes top-left, top-right, bottom-right, so next it goes bottom-left, and the slanting line points to the top-right corner. Option 4 is the third figure turned once more. Option 2 also has + at bottom-left, but its lines are a flipped picture, not a turn.
trick: Turn the whole figure in your head 90 degrees; check every line, not only the + sign.
